missions.title: Ordering noodles
missions.goal: Order a bowl of noodles and a drink, then pay.

steps.partner_zh: 你好！几位？
steps.partner_en: Hello! How many of you?
steps.prompt_en: Say it's just you, one person.
answers_zh: 一个人。
就我一个人。
answers_en: One person.
Just me.

steps.partner_zh: 请坐。你想吃什么？
steps.partner_en: Please sit. What would you like to eat?
steps.prompt_en: Say you want a bowl of beef noodles.
answers_zh: 我要一碗牛肉面。
一碗牛肉面，谢谢。
answers_en: I'd like a bowl of beef noodles.
A bowl of beef noodles, thanks.

steps.partner_zh: 好的。喝什么？
steps.partner_en: OK. Anything to drink?
steps.prompt_en: Ask for a cup of tea.
answers_zh: 我要一杯茶。
一杯茶吧。
answers_en: I'd like a cup of tea.
A cup of tea, please.

steps.partner_zh: 你的面来了。好吃吗？
steps.partner_en: Here are your noodles. Are they good?
steps.prompt_en: Say they're delicious, and ask for the bill.
answers_zh: 很好吃！买单。
非常好吃，买单吧。
answers_en: Delicious! The bill, please.
Really tasty. Let's have the bill.

steps.partner_zh: 一共二十八块。
steps.partner_en: That's twenty-eight kuai altogether.
steps.prompt_en: Say you'll pay by phone.
answers_zh: 我用手机付。
可以用手机吗？
answers_en: I'll pay by phone.
Can I use my phone?

missions.closing_zh: 可以。谢谢，再见！
missions.closing_en: Sure. Thanks, goodbye!

missions.title: Taking a taxi
missions.goal: Tell the driver where to go and pay at the end.

steps.partner_zh: 你好，去哪儿？
steps.partner_en: Hi, where to?
steps.prompt_en: Say you're going to the train station.
answers_zh: 我去火车站。
去火车站，谢谢。
answers_en: I'm going to the train station.
The train station, thanks.

steps.partner_zh: 好。你是哪国人？
steps.partner_en: OK. Where are you from?
steps.prompt_en: Say you're British.
answers_zh: 我是英国人。
英国人。
answers_en: I'm British.
British.

steps.partner_zh: 你的汉语很好！学了多长时间？
steps.partner_en: Your Chinese is good! How long have you studied?
steps.prompt_en: Say thank you, and that you've studied for one year.
answers_zh: 谢谢！我学了一年。
谢谢，一年了。
answers_en: Thanks! I've studied for a year.
Thanks, a year now.

steps.partner_zh: 到了。三十五块。
steps.partner_en: We're here. Thirty-five kuai.
steps.prompt_en: Say here you go, and thank the driver.
answers_zh: 给你。谢谢！
好的，给你钱。谢谢你！
answers_en: Here you go. Thanks!
OK, here's the money. Thank you!

missions.closing_zh: 不客气，再见！
missions.closing_en: You're welcome, bye!

missions.title: Buying fruit
missions.goal: Buy some apples and haggle a little.

steps.partner_zh: 你好！要买什么？
steps.partner_en: Hello! What would you like?
steps.prompt_en: Ask how much the apples are.
answers_zh: 苹果多少钱？
苹果多少钱一斤？
answers_en: How much are the apples?
How much are the apples per jin?

steps.partner_zh: 十块一斤。
steps.partner_en: Ten kuai a jin.
steps.prompt_en: Say it's too expensive.
answers_zh: 太贵了！
太贵了，便宜一点儿吧。
answers_en: Too expensive!
Too expensive, make it a bit cheaper.

steps.partner_zh: 那八块吧。要几斤？
steps.partner_en: Eight then. How many jin?
steps.prompt_en: Say you want two jin.
answers_zh: 我要两斤。
两斤，谢谢。
answers_en: I'd like two jin.
Two jin, thanks.

steps.partner_zh: 好的，十六块。还要别的吗？
steps.partner_en: OK, sixteen kuai. Anything else?
steps.prompt_en: Say no thanks, that's all.
answers_zh: 不要了，谢谢。
就这些。
answers_en: Nothing else, thanks.
That's all.

missions.closing_zh: 好，慢走！
missions.closing_en: OK, take care!

missions.title: Meeting a classmate
missions.goal: Introduce yourself to a new classmate.

steps.partner_zh: 你好！我叫小明。你叫什么名字？
steps.partner_en: Hi! I'm Xiao Ming. What's your name?
steps.prompt_en: Say hello and tell him your name.
answers_zh: 你好！我叫约翰。
你好，我的名字是约翰。
answers_en: Hi! I'm John.
Hi, my name is John.

steps.partner_zh: 你是学生吗？
steps.partner_en: Are you a student?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, you study accounting.
answers_zh: 是，我学习会计。
是的，我是学会计的。
answers_en: Yes, I study accounting.
Yes, I'm an accounting student.

steps.partner_zh: 你喜欢做什么？
steps.partner_en: What do you like doing?
steps.prompt_en: Say you like watching football.
answers_zh: 我喜欢看足球。
我很喜欢看足球比赛。
answers_en: I like watching football.
I really like watching football matches.

steps.partner_zh: 我也喜欢！星期六一起看吧？
steps.partner_en: Me too! Shall we watch together on Saturday?
steps.prompt_en: Say great, see you Saturday.
answers_zh: 好啊！星期六见。
太好了，星期六见！
answers_en: Sure! See you Saturday.
Great, see you Saturday!

missions.closing_zh: 好，星期六见！
missions.closing_en: OK, see you Saturday!

missions.title: At a café
missions.goal: Order a coffee to take away.

steps.partner_zh: 你好，喝点儿什么？
steps.partner_en: Hi, what would you like to drink?
steps.prompt_en: Ask for a hot coffee.
answers_zh: 我要一杯热咖啡。
一杯热咖啡，谢谢。
answers_en: I'd like a hot coffee.
A hot coffee, thanks.

steps.partner_zh: 大杯还是小杯？
steps.partner_en: Large or small?
steps.prompt_en: Say large.
answers_zh: 大杯。
大杯的，谢谢。
answers_en: Large.
A large one, thanks.

steps.partner_zh: 在这儿喝还是带走？
steps.partner_en: Drink here or take away?
steps.prompt_en: Say take away.
answers_zh: 带走。
打包带走。
answers_en: Take away.
To take away.

steps.partner_zh: 好的，二十五块。
steps.partner_en: OK, twenty-five kuai.
steps.prompt_en: Say here you go.
answers_zh: 给你。
好，给你。
answers_en: Here you go.
OK, here you are.

missions.closing_zh: 请等一下，马上好。
missions.closing_en: Please wait a moment, it'll be right up.

missions.title: Asking the way
missions.goal: Find out where the metro station is.

steps.partner_zh: 你好，有什么事吗？
steps.partner_en: Hi, can I help?
steps.prompt_en: Ask where the metro station is.
answers_zh: 请问，地铁站在哪儿？
你好，地铁站在哪儿？
answers_en: Excuse me, where's the metro station?
Hi, where's the metro station?

steps.partner_zh: 在前面，你往前走。
steps.partner_en: It's ahead. Walk straight on.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if it's far.
answers_zh: 远吗？
离这儿远不远？
answers_en: Is it far?
Is it far from here?

steps.partner_zh: 不远，走五分钟就到了。
steps.partner_en: Not far, five minutes' walk.
steps.prompt_en: Say thank you very much.
answers_zh: 谢谢你！
太谢谢了！
answers_en: Thank you!
Thanks so much!

missions.closing_zh: 不客气！
missions.closing_en: You're welcome!

missions.title: Buying a jacket
missions.goal: Try on a jacket and buy it.

steps.partner_zh: 欢迎光临！你想买什么？
steps.partner_en: Welcome! What are you looking for?
steps.prompt_en: Say you want to look at that black jacket.
answers_zh: 我想看看那件黑色的衣服。
我要看那件黑的。
answers_en: I'd like to look at that black jacket.
I want to see that black one.

steps.partner_zh: 这件吗？你可以试试。
steps.partner_en: This one? You can try it on.
steps.prompt_en: Say it's a bit big, and ask for a smaller one.
answers_zh: 有点儿大。有小的吗？
太大了，有小一点儿的吗？
answers_en: It's a bit big. Is there a smaller one?
Too big. Is there a smaller one?

steps.partner_zh: 有，你看这件。
steps.partner_en: Yes, try this one.
steps.prompt_en: Say this one is good, you want it.
answers_zh: 这件很好，我要这个。
好看！我要这件。
answers_en: This one's good, I'll take it.
Looks great! I'll take this one.

steps.partner_zh: 三百块。
steps.partner_en: Three hundred kuai.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if it can be cheaper.
answers_zh: 可以便宜一点儿吗？
太贵了，便宜点儿吧。
answers_en: Can it be a bit cheaper?
Too expensive, cheaper please.

missions.closing_zh: 好吧，两百八十块。
missions.closing_en: Alright, two hundred and eighty.

missions.title: Football chat
missions.goal: Chat with a friend about last night's match.

steps.partner_zh: 你昨天看足球了吗？
steps.partner_en: Did you watch the football yesterday?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, you watched it.
answers_zh: 看了！
看了，很好看。
answers_en: I did!
Yes, it was great.

steps.partner_zh: 你喜欢哪个球队？
steps.partner_en: Which team do you like?
steps.prompt_en: Say you like the red team.
answers_zh: 我喜欢红色的球队。
红队！
answers_en: I like the red team.
The reds!

steps.partner_zh: 他们赢了吗？
steps.partner_en: Did they win?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, they won two-one.
answers_zh: 赢了，二比一。
他们赢了，二比一！
answers_en: They won, two-one.
They won, two-one!

steps.partner_zh: 太好了！下次我们一起看吧。
steps.partner_en: Great! Let's watch together next time.
steps.prompt_en: Agree and suggest your place.
answers_zh: 好啊，来我家看吧。
好！在我家看。
answers_en: Sure, come and watch at mine.
OK! At my place.

missions.closing_zh: 好，我带水果来！
missions.closing_en: OK, I'll bring fruit!

missions.title: Checking into a hotel
missions.goal: Check in, ask about breakfast and Wi-Fi.

steps.partner_zh: 晚上好！请问有预订吗？
steps.partner_en: Good evening! Do you have a booking?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, you booked a room for two nights.
answers_zh: 有，我订了一个房间，住两个晚上。
有，两个晚上。
answers_en: Yes, I booked a room for two nights.
Yes, two nights.

steps.partner_zh: 请给我看一下您的护照。
steps.partner_en: May I see your passport, please?
steps.prompt_en: Hand it over: say here you go.
answers_zh: 好的，给您。
在这儿，给您。
answers_en: Sure, here you are.
Here it is.

steps.partner_zh: 好了，您的房间在八楼。
steps.partner_en: All done, your room is on the eighth floor.
steps.prompt_en: Ask what time breakfast is.
answers_zh: 早饭几点开始？
请问早饭是几点？
answers_en: What time does breakfast start?
Excuse me, what time is breakfast?

steps.partner_zh: 早上七点到十点，在二楼。
steps.partner_en: Seven to ten in the morning, on the second floor.
steps.prompt_en: Ask for the Wi-Fi password.
answers_zh: 无线网的密码是多少？
请问网络密码是什么？
answers_en: What's the Wi-Fi password?
What's the internet password, please?

steps.partner_zh: 密码在房卡后面。
steps.partner_en: The password is on the back of your key card.
steps.prompt_en: Thank her and say goodnight.
answers_zh: 好的，谢谢！晚安。
谢谢你，晚安！
answers_en: OK, thanks! Goodnight.
Thank you, goodnight!

missions.closing_zh: 不客气，祝您住得愉快！
missions.closing_en: You're welcome, enjoy your stay!

missions.title: Messaging a Xianyu seller
missions.goal: Ask about a second-hand jacket and agree a price.

steps.partner_zh: 你好，在的。
steps.partner_en: Hi, I'm here.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if the jacket is still available.
answers_zh: 你好，这件外套还在吗？
请问这件衣服还有吗？
answers_en: Hi, is this jacket still available?
Is this jacket still for sale?

steps.partner_zh: 还在，只穿过两次。
steps.partner_en: Still here, only worn twice.
steps.prompt_en: Ask what size it is.
answers_zh: 是多大号的？
这件是什么尺码？
answers_en: What size is it?
What size is this one?

steps.partner_zh: 是二号，比较宽松。
steps.partner_en: It's a size 2, fairly loose.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if 500 kuai is OK.
answers_zh: 五百块可以吗？
五百卖吗？
answers_en: Would 500 be OK?
Would you sell it for 500?

steps.partner_zh: 最低六百，包邮。
steps.partner_en: Six hundred minimum, free shipping.
steps.prompt_en: Accept and say you'll pay now.
answers_zh: 好吧，我现在拍。
行，那我现在付钱。
answers_en: OK, I'll buy it now.
Fine, I'll pay now.

missions.closing_zh: 好的，我明天发货。
missions.closing_en: Great, I'll ship it tomorrow.

missions.title: At the pharmacy
missions.goal: Explain you have a cold and buy medicine.

steps.partner_zh: 你好，哪里不舒服？
steps.partner_en: Hello, what's wrong?
steps.prompt_en: Say you have a cold and a sore throat.
answers_zh: 我感冒了，嗓子疼。
我好像感冒了，嗓子很疼。
answers_en: I have a cold and a sore throat.
I think I've got a cold; my throat really hurts.

steps.partner_zh: 发烧吗？
steps.partner_en: Do you have a fever?
steps.prompt_en: Say a little, since yesterday.
answers_zh: 有一点儿，从昨天开始。
昨天开始有点儿发烧。
answers_en: A little, since yesterday.
A slight fever since yesterday.

steps.partner_zh: 这个药一天吃三次，一次两片。
steps.partner_en: Take this medicine three times a day, two tablets each time.
steps.prompt_en: Ask whether to take it before or after meals.
answers_zh: 饭前吃还是饭后吃？
是吃饭以前吃吗？
answers_en: Before or after meals?
Do I take it before eating?

steps.partner_zh: 饭后吃。多喝水，多休息。
steps.partner_en: After meals. Drink lots of water and rest.
steps.prompt_en: Say OK and ask how much.
answers_zh: 好的，多少钱？
知道了，一共多少钱？
answers_en: OK, how much?
Got it. How much altogether?

missions.closing_zh: 三十六块。希望你早点儿好！
missions.closing_en: Thirty-six kuai. Hope you feel better soon!

missions.title: Buying a train ticket
missions.goal: Buy a high-speed train ticket to Hangzhou.

steps.partner_zh: 您好，去哪里？
steps.partner_en: Hello, where to?
steps.prompt_en: Say one ticket to Hangzhou, please.
answers_zh: 一张去杭州的票。
我要一张到杭州的票。
answers_en: One ticket to Hangzhou.
I'd like a ticket to Hangzhou.

steps.partner_zh: 什么时候走？
steps.partner_en: When are you travelling?
steps.prompt_en: Say this afternoon, around three.
answers_zh: 今天下午，三点左右。
今天下午三点左右的。
answers_en: This afternoon, around three.
One around three this afternoon.

steps.partner_zh: 三点十分有一趟高铁，二等座一百二十块。
steps.partner_en: There's a high-speed train at 3:10; second class is 120 kuai.
steps.prompt_en: Say fine, and ask for a window seat.
answers_zh: 可以。有靠窗的座位吗？
好，我要靠窗的。
answers_en: Fine. Is there a window seat?
OK, I'd like a window seat.

steps.partner_zh: 有。请出示一下证件。
steps.partner_en: Yes. Please show your ID.
steps.prompt_en: Say here's your passport.
answers_zh: 这是我的护照。
给您，我的护照。
answers_en: Here's my passport.
Here you are, my passport.

missions.closing_zh: 好了，七号车厢，祝您旅途愉快。
missions.closing_en: All set, carriage seven. Have a good trip.

missions.title: The delivery rider calls
missions.goal: Explain where you are so your food arrives.

steps.partner_zh: 喂，你好，你的外卖到了。你在哪儿？
steps.partner_en: Hello, your food's here. Where are you?
steps.prompt_en: Say you're in building 3, room 502.
answers_zh: 我在三号楼五零二。
三号楼，五零二房间。
answers_en: I'm in building 3, 502.
Building 3, room 502.

steps.partner_zh: 小区门口的保安不让我进。
steps.partner_en: The guard at the estate gate won't let me in.
steps.prompt_en: Say you'll come down to get it.
answers_zh: 那我下来拿吧。
没关系，我下去拿。
answers_en: Then I'll come down for it.
No problem, I'll come down.

steps.partner_zh: 好的，我在门口等你。
steps.partner_en: OK, I'll wait at the gate.
steps.prompt_en: Say you'll be there in five minutes.
answers_zh: 五分钟就到。
我五分钟以后到。
answers_en: I'll be there in five minutes.
I'll get there in five minutes.

steps.partner_zh: 给你，小心，汤很烫。
steps.partner_en: Here you go. Careful, the soup's hot.
steps.prompt_en: Thank him, and say sorry for the trouble.
answers_zh: 谢谢，麻烦你了！
辛苦了，谢谢！
answers_en: Thanks, sorry for the trouble!
Thanks for your hard work!

missions.closing_zh: 没事，记得给个好评哦！
missions.closing_en: No worries, remember to leave a good review!

missions.title: Getting a haircut
missions.goal: Explain how you want your hair cut.

steps.partner_zh: 你好，今天想怎么剪？
steps.partner_en: Hi, how would you like it cut today?
steps.prompt_en: Say shorter, but not too short.
answers_zh: 剪短一点儿，别太短。
短一点儿，可是不要太短。
answers_en: A bit shorter, not too short.
Shorter, but not too short.

steps.partner_zh: 两边也剪吗？
steps.partner_en: The sides too?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, the sides shorter, the top a bit longer.
answers_zh: 两边短一点儿，上面长一点儿。
对，两边剪短，上面留长一点儿。
answers_en: Sides shorter, top a bit longer.
Yes, sides short, leave the top a bit longer.

steps.partner_zh: 要不要洗头？
steps.partner_en: Would you like a wash?
steps.prompt_en: Say no need, and ask how much.
answers_zh: 不用了。多少钱？
不洗了，一共多少钱？
answers_en: No need. How much?
No wash. How much altogether?

steps.partner_zh: 好了，你看看怎么样？
steps.partner_en: Done. How does it look?
steps.prompt_en: Say it looks great, thanks.
answers_zh: 很好看，谢谢！
非常好，我很满意。
answers_en: Looks great, thanks!
Really good, I'm very happy with it.

missions.closing_zh: 四十块。欢迎下次再来！
missions.closing_en: Forty kuai. Come again!

missions.title: Making weekend plans
missions.goal: Arrange to see a film with a friend.

steps.partner_zh: 这个周末你有空吗？
steps.partner_en: Are you free this weekend?
steps.prompt_en: Say Saturday afternoon you're free.
answers_zh: 星期六下午有空。
周六下午我有时间。
answers_en: I'm free Saturday afternoon.
I have time on Saturday afternoon.

steps.partner_zh: 我们去看电影吧？有一个新的动画电影。
steps.partner_en: Shall we see a film? There's a new animated one.
steps.prompt_en: Say great, you've wanted to see it for ages.
answers_zh: 好啊！我早就想看了。
太好了，我一直想看。
answers_en: Sure! I've wanted to see it for ages.
Great, I've been wanting to see it.

steps.partner_zh: 那几点见？在哪儿见？
steps.partner_en: So what time and where shall we meet?
steps.prompt_en: Suggest two o'clock at the cinema entrance.
answers_zh: 两点在电影院门口见吧。
下午两点，电影院门口。
answers_en: Let's meet at two at the cinema entrance.
Two pm, cinema entrance.

steps.partner_zh: 好，我来买票。
steps.partner_en: OK, I'll buy the tickets.
steps.prompt_en: Say then you'll buy the snacks and drinks.
answers_zh: 那我买吃的和喝的。
好，零食和饮料我来买。
answers_en: Then I'll get food and drinks.
OK, I'll buy the snacks and drinks.

missions.closing_zh: 好，周六见！
missions.closing_en: Great, see you Saturday!

missions.title: Returning shoes
missions.goal: Exchange a pair of shoes that are too small.

steps.partner_zh: 您好，有什么可以帮您？
steps.partner_en: Hello, how can I help?
steps.prompt_en: Say you bought these shoes yesterday but they're too small.
answers_zh: 我昨天买了这双鞋，可是太小了。
这双鞋是昨天买的，有点儿小。
answers_en: I bought these shoes yesterday, but they're too small.
I bought these yesterday; they're a bit small.

steps.partner_zh: 您想换还是退？
steps.partner_en: Would you like to exchange or return them?
steps.prompt_en: Say you'd like to exchange for a bigger size.
answers_zh: 我想换大一号的。
换一双大一点儿的吧。
answers_en: I'd like to swap for one size up.
Let me swap for a bigger pair.

steps.partner_zh: 有小票吗？
steps.partner_en: Do you have the receipt?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, here it is.
answers_zh: 有，在这儿。
有，给您。
answers_en: Yes, here it is.
Yes, here you are.

steps.partner_zh: 您试试这双，四十三号的。
steps.partner_en: Try these, a size 43.
steps.prompt_en: Say they fit perfectly.
answers_zh: 这双正好。
很合适，就要这双。
answers_en: These fit perfectly.
They fit well, I'll take these.

missions.closing_zh: 好的，给您换好了。
missions.closing_en: All right, they're exchanged for you.

missions.title: Bargaining at the market
missions.goal: Haggle for a vintage leather bag at a market stall.

steps.partner_zh: 随便看看，这些都是老货。
steps.partner_en: Have a look, these are all old pieces.
steps.prompt_en: Ask how much the brown leather bag is.
answers_zh: 那个棕色的皮包多少钱？
请问这个皮包怎么卖？
answers_en: How much is that brown leather bag?
How much is this leather bag?

steps.partner_zh: 这个是八十年代的，八百块。
steps.partner_en: This one's from the eighties. Eight hundred.
steps.prompt_en: Point out it's a bit worn and offer four hundred.
answers_zh: 有点儿旧了，四百怎么样？
这里都磨坏了，四百块吧。
answers_en: It's a bit worn, how about four hundred?
It's worn here; four hundred.

steps.partner_zh: 四百太少了，我进货都不止这个价。
steps.partner_en: Four hundred's too little; I paid more than that for it.
steps.prompt_en: Say you're a student and offer five hundred as your final price.
answers_zh: 我是学生，五百，不能再多了。
五百吧，这是我最后的价格。
answers_en: I'm a student; five hundred, I can't go higher.
Five hundred, that's my final price.

steps.partner_zh: 唉，六百，你拿走。
steps.partner_en: Sigh, six hundred and it's yours.
steps.prompt_en: Pretend to walk away politely.
answers_zh: 那算了，我再看看别的。
太贵了，我去别家看看。
answers_en: Never mind, I'll look at other things.
Too expensive, I'll try elsewhere.

steps.partner_zh: 好好好，五百五，真的不能再少了！
steps.partner_en: Fine, fine, five-fifty, I really can't go lower!
steps.prompt_en: Accept the deal.
answers_zh: 成交！
好吧，五百五就五百五。
answers_en: Deal!
Alright, five-fifty it is.

missions.closing_zh: 你真会讲价！下次再来啊。
missions.closing_en: You really know how to haggle! Come again.

missions.title: Seeing a doctor
missions.goal: Describe your symptoms and understand the advice.

steps.partner_zh: 你好，哪里不舒服？
steps.partner_en: Hello, what seems to be the problem?
steps.prompt_en: Say your stomach has hurt since last night.
answers_zh: 我从昨天晚上开始肚子疼。
昨天晚上起肚子一直疼。
answers_en: My stomach has hurt since last night.
My stomach has been hurting since last night.

steps.partner_zh: 昨天吃了什么？
steps.partner_en: What did you eat yesterday?
steps.prompt_en: Say you had spicy hotpot and a cold drink.
answers_zh: 吃了很辣的火锅，还喝了冰饮料。
我吃了火锅，喝了冰的。
answers_en: Very spicy hotpot, and a cold drink.
I had hotpot and something iced.

steps.partner_zh: 有没有拉肚子？
steps.partner_en: Any diarrhoea?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, three times this morning.
answers_zh: 有，今天早上拉了三次。
拉了，早上三次。
answers_en: Yes, three times this morning.
Yes, three times in the morning.

steps.partner_zh: 应该是肠胃炎。这几天吃清淡一点儿。
steps.partner_en: It's probably gastroenteritis. Eat plain food for a few days.
steps.prompt_en: Ask whether you need to take medicine.
answers_zh: 需要吃药吗？
要不要吃什么药？
answers_en: Do I need medicine?
Should I take any medicine?

steps.partner_zh: 我给你开一点儿药，一天三次。
steps.partner_en: I'll prescribe something; three times a day.
steps.prompt_en: Ask when you can eat spicy food again.
answers_zh: 什么时候可以吃辣的？
我多久以后能吃辣？
answers_en: When can I eat spicy food?
How long until I can have spicy food?

missions.closing_zh: 至少一个星期以后。好好休息！
missions.closing_en: At least a week. Get some rest!

missions.title: Calling the landlord
missions.goal: Report a broken water heater and arrange a repair.

steps.partner_zh: 喂，你好，有什么事吗？
steps.partner_en: Hello, what's up?
steps.prompt_en: Say the water heater is broken and there's no hot water.
answers_zh: 热水器坏了，没有热水。
家里的热水器坏了，不能洗澡。
answers_en: The water heater's broken, no hot water.
The water heater's broken; I can't shower.

steps.partner_zh: 什么时候坏的？
steps.partner_en: When did it break?
steps.prompt_en: Say it stopped working the day before yesterday.
answers_zh: 前天就不能用了。
从前天开始就坏了。
answers_en: It stopped working the day before yesterday.
It's been broken since the day before yesterday.

steps.partner_zh: 我找师傅明天下午去看看，你在家吗？
steps.partner_en: I'll get a repairman to come tomorrow afternoon. Will you be in?
steps.prompt_en: Say you have class in the afternoon; ask if the morning works.
answers_zh: 我下午有课，上午可以吗？
下午不在，上午行不行？
answers_en: I have class in the afternoon; is the morning OK?
I'm out in the afternoon; does the morning work?

steps.partner_zh: 行，那就明天上午十点。
steps.partner_en: Fine, ten tomorrow morning then.
steps.prompt_en: Ask who pays for the repair.
answers_zh: 修理费谁付？
请问修的钱是您付吗？
answers_en: Who pays for the repair?
Will you be paying for the repair?

missions.closing_zh: 放心，这个我来付。
missions.closing_en: Don't worry, I'll pay for that.

missions.title: Dinner with friends
missions.goal: Order several dishes for a group, then ask for a doggy bag.

steps.partner_zh: 几位要点什么？
steps.partner_en: What would you all like?
steps.prompt_en: Ask what the restaurant's speciality is.
answers_zh: 你们这儿的招牌菜是什么？
有什么推荐的吗？
answers_en: What's your signature dish?
Anything you'd recommend?

steps.partner_zh: 我们的红烧肉和酸菜鱼都很有名。
steps.partner_en: Our braised pork and pickled-cabbage fish are both famous.
steps.prompt_en: Order both, plus a vegetable dish.
answers_zh: 那两个都要，再来一个青菜。
红烧肉、酸菜鱼，再加一个炒青菜。
answers_en: We'll have both, plus a greens dish.
Braised pork, pickled fish, and stir-fried greens.

steps.partner_zh: 酸菜鱼要辣的吗？
steps.partner_en: Would you like the fish spicy?
steps.prompt_en: Say medium spicy, because one friend can't eat very spicy food.
answers_zh: 中辣吧，我朋友不太能吃辣。
微辣就行，有人怕辣。
answers_en: Medium, my friend can't handle much spice.
Mild is fine, someone's scared of spice.

steps.partner_zh: 吃得怎么样？还需要什么吗？
steps.partner_en: How was everything? Need anything else?
steps.prompt_en: Say it was great; ask for the bill and a box for leftovers.
answers_zh: 很好吃！买单，再帮我们打包。
太好吃了。麻烦打包，然后买单。
answers_en: Delicious! The bill, and could you box this up?
So good. Please box this up, then the bill.

missions.closing_zh: 好的，马上来。
missions.closing_en: Sure, right away.

missions.title: Joining a gym
missions.goal: Ask about membership and avoid being upsold.

steps.partner_zh: 你好！想了解一下我们的会员卡吗？
steps.partner_en: Hi! Want to hear about our memberships?
steps.prompt_en: Ask how much a monthly card costs.
answers_zh: 月卡多少钱？
一个月的卡怎么收费？
answers_en: How much is a monthly card?
What's the charge for a month?

steps.partner_zh: 月卡三百，但是年卡更划算，只要两千。
steps.partner_en: Monthly is 300, but the annual card is better value, just 2,000.
steps.prompt_en: Say you'd like to try one month first.
answers_zh: 我想先试一个月。
先办月卡吧，看看习惯不习惯。
answers_en: I'd like to try one month first.
Monthly first; let's see if I get used to it.

steps.partner_zh: 我们还有私教课，第一节免费。
steps.partner_en: We also have personal training; the first session is free.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if you have to buy more sessions after the free one.
answers_zh: 免费课以后一定要买吗？
上完免费的，必须继续买吗？
answers_en: Do I have to buy more after the free one?
After the free session, must I keep buying?

steps.partner_zh: 不一定，你自己决定。
steps.partner_en: Not necessarily, it's up to you.
steps.prompt_en: Say fine, you'll sign up for the monthly card today.
answers_zh: 好，那我今天办月卡。
行，今天先办一张月卡。
answers_en: OK, I'll get the monthly card today.
Fine, a monthly card for today.

missions.closing_zh: 好的，请填一下这张表。
missions.closing_en: Great, please fill in this form.

missions.title: Lost property
missions.goal: Report a bag you left on the metro.

steps.partner_zh: 您好，需要帮忙吗？
steps.partner_en: Hello, do you need help?
steps.prompt_en: Say you left your bag on the train.
answers_zh: 我把包忘在地铁上了。
我的包落在车上了。
answers_en: I left my bag on the metro.
I left my bag on the train.

steps.partner_zh: 是几号线？大概几点？
steps.partner_en: Which line? Roughly what time?
steps.prompt_en: Say line 2, about twenty minutes ago.
answers_zh: 二号线，大概二十分钟以前。
二号线，二十分钟前下的车。
answers_en: Line 2, about twenty minutes ago.
Line 2, I got off twenty minutes ago.

steps.partner_zh: 包是什么样子的？
steps.partner_en: What does the bag look like?
steps.prompt_en: Say it's a black backpack with a laptop in it.
answers_zh: 是一个黑色的双肩包，里面有电脑。
黑色的背包，里面有一台笔记本电脑。
answers_en: A black backpack with a computer inside.
A black rucksack with a laptop in it.

steps.partner_zh: 请留一下您的电话，找到了马上通知您。
steps.partner_en: Please leave your number; we'll tell you as soon as it's found.
steps.prompt_en: Give your number and ask how long it usually takes.
answers_zh: 好的。一般要多长时间？
我的电话在这儿。大概要多久？
answers_en: OK. How long does it usually take?
Here's my number. About how long?

missions.closing_zh: 一般一两个小时就有消息。
missions.closing_en: Usually there's news within an hour or two.

missions.title: Debating a match
missions.goal: Argue about a penalty decision with another fan.

steps.partner_zh: 刚才那个点球绝对不应该给！
steps.partner_en: That penalty just now should never have been given!
steps.prompt_en: Disagree: say you think it was a foul.
answers_zh: 我觉得是犯规啊。
我不同意，那明明是犯规。
answers_en: I think it was a foul.
I disagree, it was clearly a foul.

steps.partner_zh: 他自己摔倒的，根本没碰到！
steps.partner_en: He fell over on his own, there was no contact!
steps.prompt_en: Say the replay shows he touched his leg.
answers_zh: 你看回放，他碰到腿了。
回放里很清楚，他踢到了对方的腿。
answers_en: Watch the replay, he touched the leg.
The replay's clear: he kicked the other player's leg.

steps.partner_zh: 好吧……可是裁判今天真的很偏心。
steps.partner_en: Fine... but the ref's been really biased today.
steps.prompt_en: Half-agree, and say the first half was worse.
answers_zh: 这个我同意，上半场更差。
有一点儿，上半场判得更不公平。
answers_en: That I agree with; the first half was worse.
A bit; the first half was even less fair.

steps.partner_zh: 你觉得最后谁会赢？
steps.partner_en: Who do you think will win in the end?
steps.prompt_en: Predict a two-one win for your team.
answers_zh: 我觉得我们二比一赢。
我们会赢，二比一。
answers_en: I think we'll win two-one.
We'll win, two-one.

missions.closing_zh: 那我们打个赌，输了请喝啤酒！
missions.closing_en: Let's bet on it then: loser buys the beer!

missions.title: Asking a colleague for help
missions.goal: Politely ask a colleague to explain a spreadsheet.

steps.partner_zh: 怎么了？看你好像很着急。
steps.partner_en: What's up? You look stressed.
steps.prompt_en: Say you don't understand this spreadsheet and ask if they have time.
answers_zh: 这个表格我看不懂，你现在有空吗？
不好意思，这个表我不太明白，能帮我看看吗？
answers_en: I can't make sense of this spreadsheet; are you free now?
Sorry, I don't really get this sheet; could you take a look?

steps.partner_zh: 可以，哪里不明白？
steps.partner_en: Sure, which part?
steps.prompt_en: Ask why the total in this column is different from last month.
answers_zh: 这一列的总数为什么和上个月不一样？
为什么这里的合计跟上个月不同？
answers_en: Why is this column's total different from last month?
Why doesn't this total match last month?

steps.partner_zh: 因为这个月多了两笔退款。
steps.partner_en: Because there were two extra refunds this month.
steps.prompt_en: Say you understand now, and ask where the refunds are recorded.
answers_zh: 明白了。退款记在哪儿？
原来是这样，退款在哪一页？
answers_en: Got it. Where are refunds recorded?
I see. Which sheet are the refunds on?

steps.partner_zh: 在第二页，我给你标出来。
steps.partner_en: On the second sheet; I'll highlight it for you.
steps.prompt_en: Thank them and offer to buy them a coffee.
answers_zh: 太感谢了，我请你喝咖啡！
谢谢你，下午我请你喝咖啡吧。
answers_en: Thanks so much, coffee's on me!
Thanks, let me buy you a coffee this afternoon.

missions.closing_zh: 那我就不客气了！
missions.closing_en: Then I won't say no!

missions.title: Internship interview
missions.goal: Answer common interview questions for a finance internship.

steps.partner_zh: 请先简单介绍一下你自己。
steps.partner_en: Please briefly introduce yourself.
steps.prompt_en: Say you're a third-year accounting and finance student, interested in auditing.
answers_zh: 我是会计与金融专业的大三学生，对审计很感兴趣。
我读会计和金融，现在大三，特别想做审计方面的工作。
answers_en: I'm a third-year accounting and finance student, very interested in auditing.
I study accounting and finance, third year, and really want to work in audit.

steps.partner_zh: 你为什么选择我们公司？
steps.partner_en: Why did you choose our firm?
steps.prompt_en: Say their clients are varied and the training is well known.
answers_zh: 因为贵公司的客户类型很多，培训也很有名。
我了解到你们的客户很多样，而且培训体系非常好。
answers_en: Because your clients are so varied, and your training is well known.
I learned your client base is diverse and your training system is excellent.

steps.partner_zh: 说说你的一个缺点。
steps.partner_en: Tell me about one of your weaknesses.
steps.prompt_en: Say you sometimes spend too long on details, but you're learning to manage your time.
answers_zh: 我有时候在细节上花太多时间，不过我正在学习安排时间。
我太注重细节了，有时候影响速度，现在我会先定好时间。
answers_en: I sometimes spend too long on details, but I'm learning to manage my time.
I focus too much on detail, which can slow me down; now I set time limits first.

steps.partner_zh: 如果工作压力很大，你会怎么处理？
steps.partner_en: How do you handle heavy work pressure?
steps.prompt_en: Say you'd list priorities and ask for help early if needed.
answers_zh: 我会先列出最重要的任务，需要的话早点儿请别人帮忙。
先分清轻重缓急，有问题及时跟同事沟通。
answers_en: I'd list the most important tasks first and ask for help early if needed.
Sort out priorities first, and communicate with colleagues promptly if there's a problem.

steps.partner_zh: 你有什么问题想问我们吗？
steps.partner_en: Do you have any questions for us?
steps.prompt_en: Ask what a typical day looks like for an intern.
answers_zh: 实习生一天的工作一般是怎样的？
我想了解一下实习生平时主要做什么。
answers_en: What does an intern's typical day look like?
I'd like to know what interns mainly do day to day.

missions.closing_zh: 好问题。我们一周内会通知你结果。
missions.closing_en: Good question. We'll let you know the result within a week.

missions.title: Complaining about an order
missions.goal: Get a refund for a jacket that arrived damaged.

steps.partner_zh: 您好，请问有什么可以帮您？
steps.partner_en: Hello, how can I help you?
steps.prompt_en: Say the jacket you received has a hole in the sleeve.
answers_zh: 我收到的外套袖子上有一个洞。
你好，我买的外套到了，可是袖子破了一个洞。
answers_en: The jacket I received has a hole in the sleeve.
Hi, my jacket arrived but there's a hole in the sleeve.

steps.partner_zh: 非常抱歉。方便拍张照片发给我们吗？
steps.partner_en: So sorry. Could you send us a photo?
steps.prompt_en: Say you've already sent photos in the chat.
answers_zh: 我已经在聊天里发了照片。
照片刚才已经发给你们了。
answers_en: I've already sent photos in the chat.
I sent the photos to you just now.

steps.partner_zh: 看到了。我们可以给您补偿五十元，您看可以吗？
steps.partner_en: Got them. We can offer fifty yuan compensation, is that OK?
steps.prompt_en: Decline: you'd prefer a full refund and to send it back.
answers_zh: 不用补偿，我想退货退款。
我还是希望全额退款，把衣服寄回去。
answers_en: No compensation, I want to return it for a refund.
I'd rather have a full refund and send it back.

steps.partner_zh: 好的。运费需要您先垫付。
steps.partner_en: OK. You'll need to pay the return postage first.
steps.prompt_en: Say it's their mistake, so they should pay shipping.
answers_zh: 这是你们的问题，运费应该由你们出。
质量问题不是我造成的，运费应该你们承担。
answers_en: This is your problem; you should pay the postage.
I didn't cause the defect; you should cover shipping.

missions.closing_zh: 您说得对，我们会安排快递上门取件。
missions.closing_en: You're right; we'll arrange a courier to collect it.

missions.title: Viewing a flat
missions.goal: Ask the key questions before renting a flat.

steps.partner_zh: 这套房子采光特别好，您觉得怎么样？
steps.partner_en: This flat gets great light; what do you think?
steps.prompt_en: Say it's nice, and ask how much the rent is per month.
answers_zh: 挺不错的，房租一个月多少？
感觉还可以。每个月租金是多少？
answers_en: Pretty nice. What's the monthly rent?
Seems OK. How much is rent per month?

steps.partner_zh: 四千五，押一付三。
steps.partner_en: Four thousand five, one month's deposit plus three months upfront.
steps.prompt_en: Ask whether water, electricity and internet are included.
answers_zh: 水电和网费包括在里面吗？
房租包不包水电网？
answers_en: Are water, electricity and internet included?
Does the rent include utilities and internet?

steps.partner_zh: 不包括，另外算。
steps.partner_en: Not included, charged separately.
steps.prompt_en: Say it's a bit over budget; ask if the rent is negotiable.
answers_zh: 有点儿超预算了，房租还能商量吗？
比我的预算高一点儿，可以便宜一些吗？
answers_en: That's a bit over budget; is the rent negotiable?
It's a bit above my budget; could it be cheaper?

steps.partner_zh: 如果您签一年，房东可以少两百。
steps.partner_en: If you sign for a year, the landlord will knock off two hundred.
steps.prompt_en: Say you need to think about it and will reply tomorrow.
answers_zh: 我考虑一下，明天给您答复。
让我想想，明天回复您。
answers_en: I'll think about it and get back to you tomorrow.
Let me think; I'll reply tomorrow.

missions.closing_zh: 好的，不过这套房子很抢手，您尽快哦。
missions.closing_en: Sure, but this flat's in demand, so don't wait too long.

missions.title: A problem at the bank
missions.goal: Sort out a blocked card and an international transfer.

steps.partner_zh: 您好，请问办理什么业务？
steps.partner_en: Hello, what can I do for you today?
steps.prompt_en: Say your card was blocked when you tried to pay yesterday.
answers_zh: 我的卡昨天付款的时候被冻结了。
昨天刷卡的时候，卡突然不能用了。
answers_en: My card was frozen when I paid yesterday.
When I used my card yesterday it suddenly stopped working.

steps.partner_zh: 我查一下……是因为系统检测到异常交易。
steps.partner_en: Let me check... the system detected an unusual transaction.
steps.prompt_en: Explain you were buying something from overseas.
answers_zh: 那是我在国外网站上买东西。
我当时在海外网站上付款，是我本人操作的。
answers_en: That was me buying on a foreign website.
I was paying on an overseas website; it was me.

steps.partner_zh: 好的，已经帮您解冻了。还有别的吗？
steps.partner_en: OK, I've unfrozen it. Anything else?
steps.prompt_en: Say you also want to send money to the UK and ask about the fee.
answers_zh: 我还想往英国汇款，手续费是多少？
另外我想转账到英国，要收多少手续费？
answers_en: I'd also like to send money to the UK; what's the fee?
Also, I want to transfer to the UK; how much is the fee?

steps.partner_zh: 每笔一百五十元，另外还有汇率差价。
steps.partner_en: One hundred and fifty yuan per transfer, plus the exchange rate margin.
steps.prompt_en: Ask how many working days it takes to arrive.
answers_zh: 一般几个工作日能到账？
大概多久能到？
answers_en: How many working days until it arrives?
About how long does it take?

missions.closing_zh: 一般三到五个工作日。
missions.closing_en: Usually three to five working days.

missions.title: Recruiting for five-a-side
missions.goal: Persuade a friend to join your weekly five-a-side game.

steps.partner_zh: 听说你们每周都踢球？
steps.partner_en: I hear you play football every week?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, every Thursday evening, and you're one player short.
answers_zh: 对，每周四晚上，我们正好缺一个人。
是啊，周四晚上踢五人制，现在还差一个。
answers_en: Yes, every Thursday night, and we're one short.
Yep, five-a-side Thursday nights, and we need one more.

steps.partner_zh: 可是我好久没踢了，水平很一般。
steps.partner_en: But I haven't played in ages; I'm pretty average.
steps.prompt_en: Reassure them: it's just for fun, nobody's a pro.
answers_zh: 没关系，就是玩玩，大家都不是专业的。
放心，我们主要是锻炼身体，水平都差不多。
answers_en: No worries, it's just for fun, nobody's a pro.
Don't worry, it's mainly exercise; we're all about the same level.

steps.partner_zh: 场地费怎么算？
steps.partner_en: How is the pitch fee split?
steps.prompt_en: Say it's split evenly, about forty each.
answers_zh: 大家平摊，每人大概四十块。
费用平分，一个人四十左右。
answers_en: Split evenly, about forty each.
Split equally, around forty per person.

steps.partner_zh: 那好吧，我试一次。需要带什么？
steps.partner_en: OK then, I'll try once. What should I bring?
steps.prompt_en: Say trainers (not studs) and a dark top.
answers_zh: 带双运动鞋就行，别穿钉鞋，再穿件深色的衣服。
运动鞋和一件深色上衣，场地不能穿钉鞋。
answers_en: Just trainers, no studs, and wear a dark top.
Trainers and a dark top; no studs on that pitch.

missions.closing_zh: 好，周四见，我可不保证进球啊！
missions.closing_en: OK, see you Thursday. No promises on goals!

missions.title: At the tailor's
missions.goal: Get vintage trousers altered without ruining them.

steps.partner_zh: 这条裤子要怎么改？
steps.partner_en: How do you want these trousers altered?
steps.prompt_en: Say shorten them by about three centimetres.
answers_zh: 裤腿改短三厘米左右。
麻烦帮我改短大概三公分。
answers_en: Take the legs up about three centimetres.
Please shorten them by about three centimetres.

steps.partner_zh: 这布料挺特别的，是老货吧？
steps.partner_en: This fabric's quite special. Vintage, right?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, it's from the nineties, so please keep the original hem.
answers_zh: 对，是九十年代的，请尽量保留原来的裤边。
是老的，所以原来的裤脚能不能别剪掉？
answers_en: Yes, it's from the nineties; please keep the original hem if you can.
It's vintage, so could you avoid cutting off the original hem?

steps.partner_zh: 可以往里面折，不剪，这样以后还能放长。
steps.partner_en: I can fold it inside without cutting, so it can be let down later.
steps.prompt_en: Say that's perfect and ask when it'll be ready.
answers_zh: 太好了，什么时候能改好？
这样最好，大概几天能拿？
answers_en: Perfect, when will it be ready?
That's ideal; in how many days can I collect it?

steps.partner_zh: 后天下午来拿吧，三十块。
steps.partner_en: Come back the day after tomorrow in the afternoon. Thirty kuai.
steps.prompt_en: Agree, and ask if you pay now or on collection.
answers_zh: 好的，现在付还是拿的时候付？
行，钱是现在给吗？
answers_en: OK, do I pay now or when I collect?
Fine, do I pay now?

missions.closing_zh: 拿的时候再付就行。
missions.closing_en: Just pay when you collect.

missions.title: Missed connection
missions.goal: Rebook after missing a connecting flight.

steps.partner_zh: 您好，请问有什么问题？
steps.partner_en: Hello, what's the problem?
steps.prompt_en: Say your first flight was delayed and you missed your connection.
answers_zh: 我的第一班飞机晚点了，没赶上转机。
前一班延误了，我错过了中转航班。
answers_en: My first flight was late and I missed my connection.
The previous flight was delayed; I missed my transfer.

steps.partner_zh: 请出示您的登机牌。今天最晚一班已经满了。
steps.partner_en: Your boarding pass, please. Today's last flight is full.
steps.prompt_en: Ask what the earliest flight tomorrow is.
answers_zh: 那明天最早的一班是几点？
明天最早能坐几点的飞机？
answers_en: Then what time's the earliest flight tomorrow?
What's the earliest I can fly tomorrow?

steps.partner_zh: 明天早上七点五十有一班。
steps.partner_en: There's one at 7:50 tomorrow morning.
steps.prompt_en: Ask whether the airline will provide a hotel.
answers_zh: 航空公司会安排酒店吗？
今晚住的地方你们负责吗？
answers_en: Will the airline arrange a hotel?
Are you responsible for tonight's accommodation?

steps.partner_zh: 因为是我们的原因，会给您安排酒店和晚餐。
steps.partner_en: As it was our fault, we'll arrange a hotel and dinner.
steps.prompt_en: Ask where to wait for the hotel shuttle.
answers_zh: 那我在哪儿等酒店的班车？
请问去酒店的车在哪里坐？
answers_en: Where do I wait for the hotel shuttle?
Where do I catch the bus to the hotel?

missions.closing_zh: 出门左转，三号门等就可以了。
missions.closing_en: Turn left out of here and wait at door three.

missions.title: Recommending an anime
missions.goal: Convince a classmate to try an anime you love.

steps.partner_zh: 最近有什么好看的动画推荐吗？
steps.partner_en: Any good anime to recommend lately?
steps.prompt_en: Recommend one about a boy who becomes a professional football player.
answers_zh: 有一部讲一个男孩成为职业球员的，特别好看。
我推荐一部足球动画，讲一个男孩怎么变成职业球员。
answers_en: There's one about a boy becoming a pro footballer; it's brilliant.
I'd recommend a football anime about how a boy turns pro.

steps.partner_zh: 我不太喜欢体育类的。
steps.partner_en: I'm not really into sports ones.
steps.prompt_en: Say it's really about friendship and growing up, not just football.
answers_zh: 其实它主要讲友情和成长，不只是足球。
它不光是体育，更多是关于朋友和成长的故事。
answers_en: Actually it's mainly about friendship and growing up, not just football.
It's not only sport; it's more a story about friends and growing up.

steps.partner_zh: 有多少集？太长我可没时间。
steps.partner_en: How many episodes? If it's too long I won't have time.
steps.prompt_en: Say twenty-four episodes, and the first three are enough to decide.
answers_zh: 二十四集，你看前三集就知道喜不喜欢了。
一共二十四集，先看三集，不喜欢就算了。
answers_en: Twenty-four episodes; watch the first three and you'll know.
Twenty-four in total; try three, and drop it if you don't like it.

steps.partner_zh: 好吧，那今晚试试。
steps.partner_en: Alright, I'll try it tonight.
steps.prompt_en: Say great, and tell them not to read spoilers online.
answers_zh: 太好了，千万别在网上看剧透！
好，记住别去看评论，会被剧透的。
answers_en: Great, whatever you do, don't read spoilers online!
OK, remember not to read comments or you'll get spoiled.

missions.closing_zh: 放心，看完了告诉你感想。
missions.closing_en: Don't worry, I'll tell you what I think when I'm done.

missions.title: Negotiating a salary
missions.goal: Negotiate a better starting salary politely but firmly.

steps.partner_zh: 恭喜你通过了面试。我们给你的月薪是八千，你看可以吗？
steps.partner_en: Congratulations on passing the interview. We're offering eight thousand a month; does that work?
steps.prompt_en: Thank her, and say you hoped for something closer to ten thousand.
answers_zh: 谢谢您。不过我原本期望的是一万左右。
非常感谢这个机会，但我的期望薪资是一万上下。
answers_en: Thank you. But I'd originally hoped for around ten thousand.
Thanks so much for the opportunity, but my expected salary is about ten thousand.

steps.partner_zh: 这个岗位的预算有限，你为什么觉得值一万呢？
steps.partner_en: The budget for this role is limited. Why do you think it's worth ten thousand?
steps.prompt_en: Point to your internship experience and your professional qualification progress.
answers_zh: 我有两段审计实习经历，而且已经通过了三门专业资格考试。
考虑到我的实习经验和已经取得的资格证书，我觉得这个要求是合理的。
answers_en: I have two audit internships and have already passed three professional exams.
Given my internship experience and the qualifications I've earned, I think it's a reasonable request.

steps.partner_zh: 我们最多能到九千，但试用期三个月后可以再评估。
steps.partner_en: We can go up to nine thousand at most, but we can reassess after the three-month probation.
steps.prompt_en: Ask whether the reassessment can be written into the contract.
answers_zh: 试用期后的评估能写进合同里吗？
可以把转正后调薪的条件写在合同上吗？
answers_en: Can the post-probation review be written into the contract?
Could the conditions for a raise after probation go in the contract?

steps.partner_zh: 可以，我们会注明评估标准。
steps.partner_en: Yes, we'll specify the review criteria.
steps.prompt_en: Accept, and ask about the training budget too.
answers_zh: 那我接受。另外，公司对考证有补贴吗？
好的，我同意。请问公司会报销考试费用吗？
answers_en: Then I accept. Also, does the company subsidise professional exams?
OK, I agree. Does the company reimburse exam fees?

missions.closing_zh: 有的，每年最多报销五千。欢迎加入！
missions.closing_en: Yes, up to five thousand a year. Welcome aboard!

missions.title: Authenticating a designer piece
missions.goal: Discuss whether a vintage jacket is genuine.

steps.partner_zh: 这件外套你是从哪里买的？
steps.partner_en: Where did you buy this jacket?
steps.prompt_en: Say from a second-hand app; the seller claimed it's from a 1998 collection.
answers_zh: 在二手平台上买的，卖家说是九八年那一季的。
二手软件上买的，对方说是一九九八年的系列。
answers_en: On a second-hand platform; the seller said it's from the '98 season.
From a second-hand app; they said it's from the 1998 collection.

steps.partner_zh: 从面料看，年代是对的，但这个洗标有点儿可疑。
steps.partner_en: The fabric fits the era, but this care label is a bit suspicious.
steps.prompt_en: Ask what exactly looks wrong about it.
answers_zh: 具体是哪里不对劲？
您能说说洗标到底有什么问题吗？
answers_en: What exactly looks off?
Could you explain what's wrong with the label?

steps.partner_zh: 那一季的洗标是日文和英文，这个多了法文，更像是后来的版本。
steps.partner_en: That season's labels were Japanese and English; this has French too, more like a later version.
steps.prompt_en: Ask whether that means it's fake, or just a later re-release.
answers_zh: 那说明是假的，还是只是后来复刻的？
这是仿品，还是官方后来再版的？
answers_en: Does that mean it's fake, or just a later reissue?
Is it a counterfeit, or an official later re-run?

steps.partner_zh: 针脚和纽扣都是正品的特征，我倾向于是二零零几年的正品复刻。
steps.partner_en: The stitching and buttons match genuine pieces; I lean towards an authentic reissue from the 2000s.
steps.prompt_en: Say then you paid too much for a '98 piece, and ask if you can get a written report.
answers_zh: 那我按九八年的价格买贵了。能给我出一份书面报告吗？
看来我多花了钱。可以开一份鉴定报告吗？我想找卖家协商。
answers_en: Then I overpaid at a '98 price. Could you give me a written report?
Looks like I overpaid. Can you issue a report? I want to negotiate with the seller.

missions.closing_zh: 可以，报告明天发到你邮箱。
missions.closing_en: Sure, the report will be in your inbox tomorrow.

missions.title: Noise complaint
missions.goal: Resolve a noise problem with your upstairs neighbour without a fight.

steps.partner_zh: 你好，有什么事吗？
steps.partner_en: Hi, can I help you?
steps.prompt_en: Introduce yourself as the downstairs neighbour and mention the late-night noise gently.
answers_zh: 你好，我是楼下的。最近晚上楼上有点儿吵，想跟你商量一下。
打扰了，我住你楼下。这几天半夜总能听到声音，不知道是不是你们家。
answers_en: Hi, I'm from downstairs. It's been a bit noisy at night lately; I wanted to talk it over.
Sorry to bother you, I live below. I keep hearing noise late at night; I wonder if it's from yours.

steps.partner_zh: 啊，不好意思，可能是我儿子晚上在练跳绳。
steps.partner_en: Oh, sorry, it might be my son practising skipping in the evenings.
steps.prompt_en: Say you understand kids need exercise, but after eleven you have to sleep for an early shift.
answers_zh: 我理解孩子需要锻炼，但我早上要早起上班，十一点以后能不能安静一点儿？
锻炼是好事，只是我第二天要早起，希望十一点以后能注意一下。
answers_en: I understand kids need exercise, but I start work early; could it be quieter after eleven?
Exercise is good, it's just I have to get up early; could you keep it down after eleven?

steps.partner_zh: 没问题。其实他也没地方练，外面太冷了。
steps.partner_en: No problem. The thing is he has nowhere to practise; it's too cold outside.
steps.prompt_en: Suggest putting a thick mat down, which would help a lot.
answers_zh: 要不在地上铺一块厚垫子？这样声音会小很多。
可以考虑铺个瑜伽垫，效果应该挺明显的。
answers_en: How about putting a thick mat on the floor? It'd make it much quieter.
Maybe put down a yoga mat; it should make a real difference.

steps.partner_zh: 好主意，我明天就去买。谢谢你这么客气地来说。
steps.partner_en: Good idea, I'll buy one tomorrow. Thanks for being so polite about it.
steps.prompt_en: Say not at all, neighbours should look out for each other.
answers_zh: 别客气，邻居之间互相体谅嘛。
哪里哪里，远亲不如近邻，有事随时说。
answers_en: Not at all, neighbours should be considerate of each other.
Don't mention it; a close neighbour beats a distant relative. Just say if there's anything.

missions.closing_zh: 说得对！改天请你来家里吃饭。
missions.closing_en: So true! Come round for dinner some time.

missions.title: Pitching to a client
missions.goal: Pitch your bookkeeping service to a small business owner.

steps.partner_zh: 你们的记账服务跟别人有什么不同？
steps.partner_en: How is your bookkeeping service different from others?
steps.prompt_en: Say you give a monthly cash-flow report in plain language, not just the books.
answers_zh: 我们不只是记账，每个月还会用通俗的语言给您做一份现金流报告。
除了记账，我们每月提供一份简单易懂的现金流分析。
answers_en: We don't just keep the books; every month we give you a cash-flow report in plain language.
Beyond bookkeeping, we provide an easy-to-understand monthly cash-flow analysis.

steps.partner_zh: 听起来不错，但是价格呢？我现在找的人每个月只收三百。
steps.partner_en: Sounds good, but the price? The person I use now charges only three hundred a month.
steps.prompt_en: Say you charge six hundred, but can save more than that by spotting waste.
answers_zh: 我们每月收六百，但通过发现不必要的开支，帮您省下的钱通常远不止这个数。
价格是六百，不过我们找出的浪费，一般能帮客户省下更多。
answers_en: We charge six hundred a month, but the money we save you by finding unnecessary costs is usually far more.
It's six hundred, but the waste we find usually saves clients more than that.

steps.partner_zh: 你怎么证明？
steps.partner_en: How can you prove that?
steps.prompt_en: Offer a free first month so they can judge for themselves.
answers_zh: 第一个月免费，您看了报告再决定。
我们可以先免费做一个月，效果您自己判断。
answers_en: The first month is free; decide after you see the report.
We can do a first month free, and you judge the results yourself.

steps.partner_zh: 那我需要准备什么？
steps.partner_en: So what do I need to prepare?
steps.prompt_en: Ask for the last three months of bank statements and receipts.
answers_zh: 麻烦您准备最近三个月的银行流水和发票。
只需要近三个月的银行对账单和收据就可以了。
answers_en: Please prepare the last three months' bank statements and invoices.
Just the last three months of bank statements and receipts.

missions.closing_zh: 行，下周一我让助理发给你。
missions.closing_en: Fine, I'll have my assistant send them to you next Monday.

missions.title: Fan interview after a match
missions.goal: Give a TV reporter your view on the match.

steps.partner_zh: 你好，能简单谈谈你对今天比赛的看法吗？
steps.partner_en: Hello, could you briefly share your view of today's match?
steps.prompt_en: Say the result was disappointing, but the young players showed promise.
answers_zh: 结果挺让人失望的，不过几个年轻球员表现得很有潜力。
虽然输了，但年轻球员的表现让我看到了希望。
answers_en: The result was pretty disappointing, but a few young players showed real potential.
We lost, but the young players' performance gave me hope.

steps.partner_zh: 很多球迷批评主教练换人太保守，你怎么看？
steps.partner_en: Many fans criticise the head coach's substitutions as too conservative. What do you think?
steps.prompt_en: Agree partly: he should have brought on the striker earlier.
answers_zh: 我部分同意，他应该早点儿把前锋换上来。
有一定道理，前锋如果早二十分钟上场，结果可能不一样。
answers_en: I partly agree; he should have brought the striker on earlier.
There's something in it; if the striker had come on twenty minutes earlier, it might have been different.

steps.partner_zh: 你对下一场有信心吗？
steps.partner_en: Are you confident about the next match?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, playing at home the atmosphere will lift the team.
answers_zh: 有信心，下一场是主场，气氛会帮球队提升士气。
当然，回到主场，球迷的支持会让他们发挥得更好。
answers_en: Yes, the next one's at home; the atmosphere will lift the team's morale.
Of course; back at home, the fans' support will help them play better.

steps.partner_zh: 最后想对球队说点儿什么？
steps.partner_en: Anything you'd like to say to the team?
steps.prompt_en: Say keep your heads up, the fans are behind you.
answers_zh: 别灰心，我们球迷永远支持你们！
抬起头来，不管输赢我们都在。
answers_en: Don't lose heart, we fans will always back you!
Heads up; win or lose, we're here.

missions.closing_zh: 谢谢你接受采访！
missions.closing_en: Thanks for the interview!

missions.title: Booking a guesthouse by phone
missions.goal: Book a room for a special trip and arrange extras.

steps.partner_zh: 你好，这里是云水民宿。
steps.partner_en: Hello, Yunshui Guesthouse.
steps.prompt_en: Say you'd like to book a double room with a view for next weekend, two nights.
answers_zh: 您好，我想订下周末两晚的双人房，最好能看到风景的。
你好，下个周末我想订一间景观房，住两个晚上。
answers_en: Hello, I'd like to book a double room for two nights next weekend, ideally with a view.
Hi, I'd like a room with a view next weekend, two nights.

steps.partner_zh: 有一间湖景房，但是周六涨价，要六百八。
steps.partner_en: There's a lake-view room, but prices go up on Saturday: 680.
steps.prompt_en: Say that's fine, it's your parents' anniversary, and ask if you could arrange flowers.
answers_zh: 没问题。是我父母的结婚纪念日，能帮忙准备一束花吗？
可以。这次是给爸妈庆祝纪念日的，房间里能放些花吗？
answers_en: No problem. It's my parents' wedding anniversary; could you arrange some flowers?
Fine. It's to celebrate my parents' anniversary; could you put some flowers in the room?

steps.partner_zh: 当然可以，我们还可以做一桌本地菜。
steps.partner_en: Of course, and we can also cook a table of local dishes.
steps.prompt_en: Ask whether dishes can be less oily, as your dad has high blood pressure.
answers_zh: 太好了。我爸血压高，菜能少放点儿油和盐吗？
谢谢！麻烦清淡一点儿，我爸爸血压有点儿高。
answers_en: Great. My dad has high blood pressure; could you use less oil and salt?
Thanks! Please keep it light; my dad's blood pressure is a bit high.

steps.partner_zh: 明白，我们会注意的。需要接站吗？
steps.partner_en: Understood, we'll take care. Do you need a station pick-up?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes, the train arrives at 4:20 on Friday afternoon.
answers_zh: 需要，火车周五下午四点二十到。
要的，我们周五下午四点二十到站，麻烦了。
answers_en: Yes, the train gets in at 4:20 on Friday afternoon.
Yes please, we arrive at 4:20 Friday afternoon. Thanks for the trouble.

missions.closing_zh: 好的，到时候在出站口等你们。
missions.closing_en: Great, we'll wait for you at the station exit.

missions.title: Asking for an extension
missions.goal: Ask your supervisor for more time on your dissertation.

steps.partner_zh: 你的论文初稿周五能交吗？
steps.partner_en: Can you hand in your dissertation draft on Friday?
steps.prompt_en: Say honestly you're behind, because the survey data came back late.
answers_zh: 说实话，我进度落后了，因为问卷数据回来得比较晚。
不好意思，我可能来不及，调查数据晚到了一个星期。
answers_en: Honestly, I'm behind, because the survey data came back late.
Sorry, I might not make it; the survey data arrived a week late.

steps.partner_zh: 那你需要多少时间？
steps.partner_en: So how much time do you need?
steps.prompt_en: Ask for one more week, and offer to send the finished chapters now.
answers_zh: 能再给我一个星期吗？写好的章节我可以先发给您。
希望能延长一周，已完成的部分我今天就发给您。
answers_en: Could I have one more week? I can send the finished chapters first.
I'd like a one-week extension; I'll send the finished parts today.

steps.partner_zh: 可以，但数据分析部分是重点，不能马虎。
steps.partner_en: OK, but the data analysis is the key part; don't be sloppy.
steps.prompt_en: Say you understand, and ask if you could book a meeting to discuss the method.
answers_zh: 明白。我能约个时间跟您讨论一下分析方法吗？
我知道。下周方便的话，想跟您当面确认一下方法。
answers_en: Understood. Could I book a time to discuss the analysis method with you?
I know. If convenient next week, I'd like to confirm the method with you in person.

steps.partner_zh: 周二下午三点，来我办公室。
steps.partner_en: Tuesday at three, come to my office.
steps.prompt_en: Thank them for their understanding.
answers_zh: 好的，谢谢您的理解！
非常感谢，周二见。
answers_en: OK, thank you for understanding!
Thank you very much, see you Tuesday.

missions.closing_zh: 别客气，加油。
missions.closing_en: You're welcome. Keep going.

missions.title: Debating an adaptation
missions.goal: Argue whether a live-action adaptation ruins the original.

steps.partner_zh: 你看了那部真人版吗？我觉得完全毁了原作。
steps.partner_en: Did you see the live-action version? I think it totally ruined the original.
steps.prompt_en: Say you think it's not that bad; the visuals were faithful.
answers_zh: 我觉得没那么差，画面还是挺还原的。
也没有那么糟糕吧，场景还原得很用心。
answers_en: I don't think it's that bad; the visuals were pretty faithful.
It's not that terrible; they took care recreating the settings.

steps.partner_zh: 可是主角的性格完全变了！
steps.partner_en: But the main character's personality totally changed!
steps.prompt_en: Concede that's true, but a two-hour film has to simplify.
answers_zh: 这点我承认，不过两个小时的电影总得有所取舍。
确实改了很多，但电影篇幅有限，不可能全部照搬。
answers_en: I'll grant that, but a two-hour film has to make trade-offs.
They did change a lot, but a film's length is limited; it can't copy everything.

steps.partner_zh: 那为什么不干脆拍成电视剧？
steps.partner_en: Then why not just make it a TV series?
steps.prompt_en: Suggest it's about budget and risk: films are easier to finance.
answers_zh: 估计是资金和风险的问题，电影更容易拉到投资。
我猜是成本考虑，电影的投资回报更明确。
answers_en: Probably money and risk; films attract investment more easily.
I guess it's cost; a film's return on investment is clearer.

steps.partner_zh: 有道理。不过我还是更喜欢原作。
steps.partner_en: Fair point. But I still prefer the original.
steps.prompt_en: Agree the original is better, and say at least the film brings new readers.
answers_zh: 原作当然更好，至少电影能吸引一些新读者。
我也同意，不过它让更多人去看原作，也算好事。
answers_en: The original's better, of course; at least the film brings in new readers.
I agree, but if it sends more people to the original, that's a good thing.

missions.closing_zh: 这倒是。走，去书店看看有没有新刊！
missions.closing_en: True. Come on, let's see if the bookshop has the new volume!

missions.title: Challenging a client's numbers
missions.goal: As an auditor, press a finance director on suspicious receivables.

steps.partner_zh: 报表我们都核对过了，应该没什么问题吧？
steps.partner_en: We've checked the statements; there shouldn't be any problems, right?
steps.prompt_en: Say overall it's fine, but receivables grew much faster than revenue and you need an explanation.
answers_zh: 整体没问题，但应收账款的增速远高于营收，我们需要一个合理的解释。
大部分都没问题，只是应收账款增长了八成，而收入只增长了三成，这点需要说明。
answers_en: Overall it's fine, but receivables grew far faster than revenue; we need a reasonable explanation.
Most of it's fine, but receivables rose eighty percent while revenue rose only thirty; that needs explaining.

steps.partner_zh: 那是因为我们今年放宽了信用政策，为了抢占市场。
steps.partner_en: That's because we loosened credit terms this year to grab market share.
steps.prompt_en: Ask for the board approval of the credit policy change and the ageing analysis.
answers_zh: 那请提供信用政策调整的董事会决议和应收账款账龄分析表。
能否提供政策变更的审批文件，以及应收账款的账龄明细？
answers_en: Then please provide the board resolution on the credit policy change and the receivables ageing analysis.
Could you provide the approval documents for the policy change and a detailed ageing of receivables?

steps.partner_zh: 这些……需要一点儿时间整理。
steps.partner_en: Those... will take a little time to put together.
steps.prompt_en: Say that's fine, but you'll also need to send confirmation letters to the top ten customers directly.
answers_zh: 可以理解，另外我们会直接向前十大客户发函询证。
没关系，不过前十大客户的余额我们需要独立发函确认。
answers_en: Understood; also, we'll send confirmation requests directly to the top ten customers.
No problem, but we'll need to independently confirm the top ten customers' balances.

steps.partner_zh: 有这个必要吗？这些都是长期合作的客户。
steps.partner_en: Is that necessary? These are all long-standing clients.
steps.prompt_en: Explain firmly but politely that it's a standard procedure and protects both sides.
answers_zh: 这是审计准则要求的标准程序，其实也是对贵公司的一种保护。
这是常规程序，并不是针对贵公司，结果清楚了对双方都好。
answers_en: It's a standard procedure required by auditing standards, and actually protects your company too.
It's routine, not aimed at you; clear results are good for both sides.

missions.closing_zh: 好吧，我让团队配合你们。
missions.closing_en: Fine, I'll have my team cooperate with you.

missions.title: Lending to an exhibition
missions.goal: Negotiate terms for lending your archive pieces to a museum.

steps.partner_zh: 我们非常希望借展您收藏的那几件九十年代作品。
steps.partner_en: We'd very much like to borrow those nineties pieces from your collection.
steps.prompt_en: Say you're honoured, but first ask about conservation conditions in the gallery.
answers_zh: 很荣幸，不过我想先了解一下展厅的保存条件。
这是我的荣幸。请问展厅的温湿度和光照是怎么控制的？
answers_en: I'm honoured, but I'd first like to know about the gallery's conservation conditions.
It's an honour. How are temperature, humidity and lighting controlled in the gallery?

steps.partner_zh: 恒温恒湿，照明也低于五十勒克斯，符合纺织品标准。
steps.partner_en: Constant temperature and humidity, lighting under fifty lux, meeting textile standards.
steps.prompt_en: Say good; then ask who covers insurance and transport.
answers_zh: 那很好。保险和运输费用由哪一方承担？
听起来很专业。保险和运输是博物馆负责吗？
answers_en: Good. Which party covers insurance and transport?
Sounds very professional. Does the museum handle insurance and transport?

steps.partner_zh: 全部由我们承担，按您提供的估价全额投保。
steps.partner_en: We cover it all, insured in full at your valuation.
steps.prompt_en: Request that the pieces are displayed on custom mannequins, not hung.
answers_zh: 另外，希望展品用定制的人台展示，不要直接悬挂。
我有个要求：衣服不能挂着，最好按尺寸定做人台。
answers_en: Also, I'd like the pieces shown on custom mannequins rather than hung.
One request: the clothes mustn't be hung; ideally use made-to-measure mannequins.

steps.partner_zh: 没问题。展签上希望怎么署名？
steps.partner_en: No problem. How would you like to be credited on the labels?
steps.prompt_en: Say 'private collection' is enough; you prefer to stay anonymous.
answers_zh: 写“私人收藏”就可以，我不想公开姓名。
署“私人藏家”即可，我希望保持匿名。
answers_en: "Private collection" is fine; I'd rather not give my name.
Just "private collector"; I'd like to stay anonymous.

missions.closing_zh: 完全尊重您的意见，合同草稿下周发给您。
missions.closing_en: We fully respect that; the draft contract will reach you next week.

missions.title: Pitching to an investor
missions.goal: Defend your startup's numbers under tough questions.

steps.partner_zh: 你们的用户增长很快，但我更关心的是留存率。
steps.partner_en: Your user growth is fast, but I care more about retention.
steps.prompt_en: Say thirty-day retention is forty percent, well above the industry average.
answers_zh: 我们三十天留存率是百分之四十，明显高于行业平均水平。
次月留存稳定在四成左右，比同行高出不少。
answers_en: Our thirty-day retention is forty percent, clearly above the industry average.
Month-two retention is steady at about forty percent, well above peers.

steps.partner_zh: 获客成本呢？现在流量越来越贵。
steps.partner_en: And customer acquisition cost? Traffic keeps getting pricier.
steps.prompt_en: Say most users come from referrals, so acquisition cost has fallen for three quarters.
answers_zh: 我们大部分新用户来自老用户推荐，获客成本已经连续三个季度下降。
六成以上的用户是口碑带来的，所以获客成本一直在降。
answers_en: Most new users come from referrals, so acquisition cost has fallen for three straight quarters.
Over sixty percent of users come via word of mouth, so acquisition cost keeps falling.

steps.partner_zh: 那你们什么时候能实现盈亏平衡？
steps.partner_en: So when will you break even?
steps.prompt_en: Say that with this round, you expect to break even in eighteen months.
answers_zh: 如果这轮融资到位，我们预计十八个月内实现盈亏平衡。
按现在的增长，拿到这轮资金后大约一年半能打平。
answers_en: If this round closes, we expect to break even within eighteen months.
At current growth, with this round we'd break even in about eighteen months.

steps.partner_zh: 估值方面，你们的要价偏高了。
steps.partner_en: On valuation, your ask is on the high side.
steps.prompt_en: Stay firm: say the price reflects your margins, but you're open to discussing the terms.
answers_zh: 这个估值是基于我们的毛利水平，不过具体条款我们可以商量。
价格反映的是我们的盈利能力，但在条款上我们愿意灵活一些。
answers_en: The valuation is based on our margins, but we can discuss the specific terms.
The price reflects our profitability, but we're willing to be flexible on terms.

missions.closing_zh: 好，把详细的财务模型发给我，我们内部讨论一下。
missions.closing_en: OK, send me the detailed financial model and we'll discuss internally.

missions.title: Football podcast debate
missions.goal: Argue on a podcast about money in football.

steps.partner_zh: 有人说，没有资本，就没有今天的顶级足球。你同意吗？
steps.partner_en: Some say without capital there'd be no top-level football today. Do you agree?
steps.prompt_en: Agree capital raised standards, but argue it has widened the gap between clubs.
answers_zh: 资本确实提高了比赛水平，但也拉大了俱乐部之间的差距。
我同意一半：钱带来了更好的比赛，却让强弱分化越来越严重。
answers_en: Capital has raised the standard of play, but it has also widened the gap between clubs.
I half agree: money brought better football, but made the divide between strong and weak ever sharper.

steps.partner_zh: 可是强队本来就会更强，这不是自然规律吗？
steps.partner_en: But strong teams naturally get stronger; isn't that just how it goes?
steps.prompt_en: Say without regulation that's true, which is why spending caps matter.
answers_zh: 如果没有监管，的确会这样，所以财政公平规则才这么重要。
正因为这样，才需要工资帽之类的制度来维持竞争。
answers_en: Without regulation, yes, which is exactly why financial fair play rules matter so much.
That's precisely why systems like salary caps are needed to keep competition alive.

steps.partner_zh: 但这些规则执行起来漏洞百出。
steps.partner_en: But these rules are full of loopholes in practice.
steps.prompt_en: Concede that, but say imperfect rules beat no rules.
answers_zh: 这我承认，不过有缺陷的规则总比没有规则强。
执行确实有问题，但不能因此就否定规则本身。
answers_en: I'll admit that, but flawed rules are better than none.
Enforcement has problems, but that's no reason to reject the rules themselves.

steps.partner_zh: 最后，用一句话总结你的观点。
steps.partner_en: Finally, sum up your view in one sentence.
steps.prompt_en: Say football can welcome money, but must not be owned by it.
answers_zh: 足球可以欢迎资本，但不能被资本绑架。
钱可以为足球服务，但足球不能只为钱服务。
answers_en: Football can welcome capital, but must not be held hostage by it.
Money can serve football, but football mustn't serve only money.

missions.closing_zh: 说得好！感谢今天的精彩讨论。
missions.closing_en: Well said! Thanks for a great discussion today.

missions.title: Supporting a grieving friend
missions.goal: Comfort a friend whose grandmother has died, with the right words.

steps.partner_zh: 我奶奶上周走了……我到现在还不敢相信。
steps.partner_en: My grandma passed away last week... I still can't believe it.
steps.prompt_en: Express your condolences and say you're here if they need anything.
answers_zh: 太突然了，请节哀。有什么需要帮忙的，随时告诉我。
听到这个消息我很难过。你需要什么，我都在。
answers_en: So sudden; I'm so sorry for your loss. Tell me anytime if there's anything I can do.
I'm so sad to hear it. Whatever you need, I'm here.

steps.partner_zh: 我最后悔的是，今年春节都没回去看她。
steps.partner_en: What I regret most is not going home to see her this Spring Festival.
steps.prompt_en: Gently say she surely understood, and knew how much you loved her.
answers_zh: 她一定能理解的，她肯定知道你有多爱她。
别太自责了，奶奶心里一直都明白你的心意。
answers_en: She'd surely have understood; she must have known how much you loved her.
Don't blame yourself too much; your grandma always knew how you felt.

steps.partner_zh: 她以前总给我包饺子，说是我最爱吃的。
steps.partner_en: She always used to make me dumplings, said they were my favourite.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if they'd like to make dumplings together this weekend, to remember her.
answers_zh: 要不这个周末我们一起包饺子吧，就当是纪念她。
周末我陪你包一次饺子，好不好？也算是怀念奶奶。
answers_en: How about we make dumplings together this weekend, to remember her?
Shall I make dumplings with you this weekend? A way of remembering her.

steps.partner_zh: ……好。谢谢你。
steps.partner_en: ...OK. Thank you.
steps.prompt_en: Say there's no need for thanks, and that you'll come round on Saturday.
answers_zh: 跟我还客气什么，周六我过去找你。
不用谢，周六下午我带面粉过去。
answers_en: No need to stand on ceremony with me; I'll come over on Saturday.
No need to thank me; I'll bring the flour on Saturday afternoon.

missions.closing_zh: 嗯，我等你。
missions.closing_en: Mm, I'll be waiting.

missions.title: Town hall on tourism
missions.goal: Voice a resident's concerns about overtourism at a local meeting.

steps.partner_zh: 今天开会是想听听居民对旅游开发的意见。
steps.partner_en: Today's meeting is to hear residents' views on tourism development.
steps.prompt_en: Say tourism has helped shops, but noise and short-lets are driving residents out.
answers_zh: 旅游确实带动了商铺，但噪音和短租房正在把老居民挤走。
我不反对旅游，只是现在短租太多，很多老邻居都搬走了。
answers_en: Tourism has certainly helped the shops, but noise and short-lets are pushing long-time residents out.
I'm not against tourism, but there are too many short-lets now; lots of old neighbours have moved away.

steps.partner_zh: 你有什么具体的建议吗？
steps.partner_en: Do you have any concrete suggestions?
steps.prompt_en: Propose capping short-let days per year and quiet hours after ten.
answers_zh: 建议限制短租每年的出租天数，并规定晚上十点以后保持安静。
可以给短租设一个年度天数上限，再定一个夜间静音时段。
answers_en: I suggest capping short-lets' rental days per year and requiring quiet after 10 pm.
Set an annual day limit on short-lets, and designate night-time quiet hours.

steps.partner_zh: 这样会不会影响本地的经济收入？
steps.partner_en: Won't that hurt local income?
steps.prompt_en: Argue that a liveable neighbourhood is what attracts tourists in the first place.
answers_zh: 短期可能有影响，但游客来这里，本来就是为了看真实的社区生活。
如果居民都走了，这里就只剩空壳，游客也不会再来。
answers_en: There may be a short-term hit, but tourists come here to see real neighbourhood life in the first place.
If the residents all leave, it'll be an empty shell and tourists won't come either.

steps.partner_zh: 你的意见我们会认真考虑。
steps.partner_en: We'll consider your views seriously.
steps.prompt_en: Ask for a concrete timeline and a follow-up meeting.
answers_zh: 希望能给出一个具体的时间表，下个月再开一次会跟进。
能不能定个时间，下次开会时告诉我们进展？
answers_en: I'd like a concrete timetable, and a follow-up meeting next month.
Could you set a date and update us on progress at the next meeting?

missions.closing_zh: 可以，我们下个月十五号再开一次。
missions.closing_en: Agreed; we'll meet again on the fifteenth of next month.

missions.title: Discussing a translation
missions.goal: Defend your translation choices to an editor.

steps.partner_zh: 你把原文的这个比喻完全换掉了，为什么？
steps.partner_en: You completely replaced this metaphor from the original. Why?
steps.prompt_en: Say a literal translation would confuse Chinese readers, so you used an equivalent idiom.
answers_zh: 直译的话中文读者会看不懂，所以我用了一个意思相近的成语。
原文的比喻有文化背景，照搬会让读者困惑，我就换成了对应的说法。
answers_en: A literal translation would confuse Chinese readers, so I used an idiom with a similar meaning.
The metaphor is culturally rooted; copying it would confuse readers, so I swapped in an equivalent expression.

steps.partner_zh: 可是这样会不会丢掉作者的风格？
steps.partner_en: But won't that lose the author's style?
steps.prompt_en: Concede the risk, and offer to keep the original image in a footnote.
answers_zh: 确实有这个风险，我可以在脚注里保留原来的意象。
这点您说得对，要不我加个注释，把原文的比喻说明一下？
answers_en: That's a real risk; I can keep the original image in a footnote.
You're right; shall I add a note explaining the original metaphor?

steps.partner_zh: 脚注太多会影响阅读节奏。
steps.partner_en: Too many footnotes will disrupt the reading rhythm.
steps.prompt_en: Suggest a compromise: footnotes only for key recurring images.
answers_zh: 那折中一下，只给反复出现的关键意象加注。
可以只在最重要、会反复出现的地方加注，其他的就意译。
answers_en: Then a compromise: notes only for key recurring images.
Notes only where the image is most important and recurs; translate the rest freely.

steps.partner_zh: 这个方案可以。交稿时间没问题吧？
steps.partner_en: That works. The deadline's fine, right?
steps.prompt_en: Confirm you'll deliver the revised draft by the end of the month.
answers_zh: 没问题，月底前一定交修改稿。
放心，这个月底我把修订版发给您。
answers_en: No problem, the revised draft will be in by the end of the month.
Don't worry, I'll send you the revised version by month's end.

missions.closing_zh: 好，辛苦了，期待你的修改稿。
missions.closing_en: Great, thanks for your work. Looking forward to the revision.

missions.title: Career advice from a mentor
missions.goal: Discuss whether to stay in audit or move into investment.

steps.partner_zh: 听说你在考虑跳槽去做投资？
steps.partner_en: I hear you're thinking of moving into investment?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes; audit taught you a lot, but you want to be closer to decisions.
answers_zh: 是的，审计让我学到了很多，但我更想参与到决策当中。
对，审计打下了基础，不过我希望离决策更近一些。
answers_en: Yes; audit taught me a lot, but I want to be part of the decision-making.
Right; audit gave me the foundation, but I'd like to be closer to the decisions.

steps.partner_zh: 投资的压力和不确定性可比审计大多了。
steps.partner_en: Investment has far more pressure and uncertainty than audit.
steps.prompt_en: Say you know, and that's partly why you want to try it while you're young.
answers_zh: 我知道，正因为这样，我才想趁年轻去试一试。
我明白，可是年轻的时候不试，以后可能就更没勇气了。
answers_en: I know, and that's exactly why I want to try it while I'm young.
I understand, but if I don't try while I'm young, I may never have the nerve later.

steps.partner_zh: 那你的专业资格证还考吗？
steps.partner_en: Will you still finish your professional qualification?
steps.prompt_en: Say definitely: reading financial statements is the core skill either way.
answers_zh: 一定要考完，不管做什么，看懂报表都是核心能力。
当然会，读懂财务报表在投资里一样是基本功。
answers_en: Definitely; whatever I do, understanding financial statements is the core skill.
Of course; reading statements is just as fundamental in investment.

steps.partner_zh: 想清楚了就去吧。有什么需要，随时来找我。
steps.partner_en: If you've thought it through, go for it. Come to me anytime you need anything.
steps.prompt_en: Thank them sincerely for years of guidance.
answers_zh: 真的很感谢您这几年的指导。
这些年多亏了您的提携，我一直记在心里。
answers_en: Thank you so much for your guidance these past few years.
I owe a lot to your support over the years; I'll always remember it.

missions.closing_zh: 好好干，别忘了常联系。
missions.closing_en: Do well, and don't forget to keep in touch.
